# KDBX test data

## Independent synthetic corpus

`synthetic.json` holds 7 synthetic KeePass databases and what
`tests/synthetic.rs` expects to read from them. They are public test data
generated by this repository, not real evidence, and follow this crate's
GPL-3.0-only license.

Generator: `scripts/make-kdbx-fixtures.py` at the repository root. It writes
the KDBX 3 and KDBX 4 containers, VariantDictionary, hashed and HMAC block
streams, inner header, inner streams and XML itself, on top of Python 3.10's
hashlib/hmac/gzip, cryptography 48.0.0 (AES, ChaCha20, Argon2id with a secret
and associated data), argon2-cffi (Argon2d 0x10 / 0x13), PyCryptodome
(Salsa20, ChaCha20 inner streams) and twofish 0.3.0. The Rust reader is not
used. The dependencies are needed only to regenerate:

```text
python scripts/make-kdbx-fixtures.py
just test-kdbx
```

Passwords are UTF-8 `LovelyCarve-密码`, `pw` or the empty password; keyfiles
are stored in the corpus. Key derivation costs are minimal (AES-KDF 16–64
rounds, Argon2 16–64 KiB) to keep the suite fast.

SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON with LF newlines:

`aeabc011998effa0c9fba44eab2078fa220e730dff853c7b26e4d369571e2ca4`

Update the hash when intentionally changing the corpus.

## pykeepass corpus

`pykeepass/` holds databases written by KeePass 2.x and KeePassXC; see its
README.
